changelog:
- Initial release of the "design-ads" skill: an AI-powered vertical poster/cover image generator for knowledge topics.
- Automatically creates 1200x1800 px posters in a unified dark “tech” style, using Source Han Serif and Sans fonts, gradient accents, and six layout templates.
- Accurately distributes content inside a 960x1500 px area, following strict space and typography rules for covers (large titles, minimal info) and inner pages (detailed layouts).
- Supports multi-image splitting for longer content, mobile-friendly font scaling, and guides users to clarify topic, template type, theme color, and content.
- HTML output is auto-rendered to PNG via Node/Puppeteer, with files copied to a timestamped downloads folder for easy access.
